recognize_zh: 多顆大型單核芽細胞，細胞核圓、染色質細緻、有核仁，細胞質豐富灰藍並有許多小空泡，左上方的芽細胞貼附/包入紅血球；左側可見一個有絲分裂像，符合伴紅血球吞噬的急性單核芽細胞白血病。
features: Numerous large blasts with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli
Red cells intimately associated with and partially enclosed by blast cytoplasm (left-center cluster), suggestive of erythrophagocytosis
Mitotic figure with condensed chromosomes at left
Few residual normal cells; one degenerating granulocyte at upper left
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large blasts with abundant gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, round nuclei with delicate chromatin, and distinct nucleoli, consistent with monoblasts. Some blasts are closely apposed to or partially enclose red blood cells, suggestive of erythrophagocytosis, and a mitotic figure is present. Residual normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia (FAB AML-M5a) with erythrophagocytosis; nonspecific esterase, flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11c), and cytogenetics for t(8;16) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Benign histiocytes have abundant cytoplasm with condensed, kidney-shaped nuclei without nucleoli, and are not accompanied by sheets of blasts.
Contains a substantial granulocytic component (at least 20% neutrophils and precursors) and MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Immature plasma cells have eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof and express CD138 rather than monocytic markers.
